purpose: Versioned action-semantic adapter repair: score the frozen Q-v02 candidate set by conditioning frozen identity probabilities on public incidence shapes, composing with assignments, and comparing with the already-fitted Q-v02 selector without fitting or calibration.

identity_sensor_split.overlap_rule: candidate family_id in sensor-support-manifest-v02 family_roster where split=train

composition.per_clause_kind_probability: softmax of frozen six-way identity head
composition.per_clause_satisfaction_probability: first mask p(kind|H_j) to clause kinds whose argument schema is fully grounded by public entity/role mention incidence; renormalize over supported kinds; then sum conditional p(kind|H_j,public incidence) times satisfaction under the candidate assignment
composition.terminal_log_score: sum_j log(p_satisfied_j); -infinity if any p_satisfied_j is zero
composition.terminal_probability: exp(terminal_log_score), interpreted under a factorized-across-clauses approximation
composition.public_incidence_support: two entities and no roles supports same/different; one entity and one role supports exactly_one/fixed/forbidden; multiple entities and one role supports exactly_one; one entity and two roles supports implies_not_role. Unsupported kinds are masked because their required arguments are absent from the public incidence.
composition.private_kind_oracle: replace identity probabilities with one-hot private clause-kind targets; offline diagnostic only
composition.implication_semantics: current generator emits same-entity implication clauses with distinct roles; these are tautologies and contribute satisfaction probability 1. If a future task has two entities and two roles, average both public-incidence-compatible pairings and label the result approximate.

adapter_repair_v03.trigger: Several hypothetical clause kinds require arguments absent from a given public incidence row, making their satisfaction undefined rather than false.
adapter_repair_v03.repair: mask identity posterior classes that are not grounded by the public entity/role incidence shape, renormalize posterior over supported kinds, then compose assignment satisfaction.
adapter_repair_v03.validated_true_kind_support: every private kind in the offline sidecar must belong to the incidence-supported kind set; mismatch fails closed.
adapter_repair_v03.version_boundary: distinct v03 source and manifest; earlier semantic adapter sources and Q-v02 artifacts remain untouched.

evaluation.candidate_data: selected-candidates.jsonl from the prepared Q-v02 data; score each row once
evaluation.q_v02_comparison: recompute the existing frozen qterminal-v02 checkpoint on the same rows using its stored validation temperature; no refit

observed_test_strata.note: Family-based stratification is required; the four family candidate counts are 5, 6, 6, and 7, so rows are not balanced 12/12 across the strata.

evaluation.heldout_generalization_warning: Q-v02 test families are not all unseen to the identity head; test metrics must be stratified and the aggregate is not an unseen-identity result.
